focus: The Curious Case of Neural Text Degeneration, Section 3.1 (Nucleus Sampling). Explain how top-p sampling chooses the smallest set of tokens whose cumulative probability reaches p and rescales it. Use a small next-token distribution the learner can edit, a slider for p, and a comparison with top-k. Check that the rescaled distribution sums to one and that p = 1 keeps every token.
audience: Undergraduate engineering students new to language models
